verdict.rationale: The firm's own public EC&VC page hosts free startup resources: an online investor-readiness check that produces a personalised report and score, plus downloadable UK and DE cap table templates. These cover the financing and equity topics, but the evidence shows no plain-language guides, FAQs or explainers. missing for 10: plain-language guides or explainers on company formation, FAQs on financing and equity, evidence of a structured open knowledge base, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, the firm maintains an open startup knowledge base — plain-language guides, FAQs, or explainers on formation, financing, and equity — on its own public pages

citations.quote: Our quick online tool will help you check, giving you a personalised report, investor-ready score and a rundown of where any gaps might be
free downloadable "Cap table (UK version)" and "Cap table (DE version)"
